question: List employee first and last names
Get orders with customer names
query: SELECT o."orderNumber", c."customerName" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

question: Get employees with office city
query: SELECT e."firstName", e."lastName", o."city" FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e."officeCode" = o."officeCode";

question: Get payments with customer names
query: SELECT p."checkNumber", p."amount", c."customerName" FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

question: Get order details with product names
query: SELECT od."orderNumber", p."productName", od."quantityOrdered", od."priceEach" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode";

question: Get products with product line description
query: SELECT p."productName", pl."textDescription" FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p."productLine" = pl."productLine";

question: Get customers with sales rep names
query: SELECT c."customerName", e."firstName" AS repFirstName, e."lastName" AS repLastName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c."salesRepEmployeeNumber" = e."employeeNumber";

question: Get orders with customer city
query: SELECT o."orderNumber", c."city" FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

question: Get employees and their manager
query: SELECT e1."firstName" AS employeeFirst, e1."lastName" AS employeeLast, e2."firstName" AS managerFirst, e2."lastName" AS managerLast FROM employees e1 LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e1."reportsTo" = e2."employeeNumber";

question: Get orderdetails with product vendor
query: SELECT od."orderNumber", p."productVendor" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode";

question: Get payments with customer country
query: SELECT p."amount", c."country" FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

question: Count customers per country
query: SELECT "country", COUNT(*) as customerCount FROM customers GROUP BY "country";

question: Total payments per customer
query: SELECT "customerNumber", SUM("amount") as totalPayment FROM payments GROUP BY "customerNumber";

question: Number of orders per status
query: SELECT "status", COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders GROUP BY "status";

question: Products per product line
query: SELECT "productLine", COUNT(*) as productCount FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

question: Employees per office
query: SELECT "officeCode", COUNT(*) as employeeCount FROM employees GROUP BY "officeCode";

question: Total stock per product vendor
query: SELECT "productVendor", SUM("quantityInStock") as totalStock FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor";

question: Average buy price per product line
query: SELECT "productLine", AVG("buyPrice") as avgBuyPrice FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

question: Orders per customer
query: SELECT "customerNumber", COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM orders GROUP BY "customerNumber";

question: Max MSRP per product line
query: SELECT "productLine", MAX("MSRP") as maxMSRP FROM products GROUP BY "productLine";

question: Min buy price per vendor
query: SELECT "productVendor", MIN("buyPrice") as minBuyPrice FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor";
